props.gloss_en: one who saw a man slaughter: if he saw him from beginning to end, he may eat of his slaughter
and if not [if he did not see it from beginning to end], he may not eat of his slaughter
proposed: the dictum speaks of one who knows the slaughterer is learned
proposed: the dictum speaks of one who knows the slaughterer is not learned
proposed: the dictum speaks of one who does not know whether the slaughterer is learned or not
the baraita: one who found a slaughtered chicken in the market, or told his agent 'go slaughter' and went and found it slaughtered -- its presumption is that it was [properly] slaughtered
most of those who are found at slaughter are experts
the dictum speaks of one who knows the slaughterer is not learned, and he cut one siman properly before us
this [siman] happened [right] for him by chance; the other -- perhaps he paused, perhaps he pressed
one who told his agent 'go slaughter' and went and found it slaughtered -- its presumption is slaughtered
one who told his agent 'go separate teruma' and went and found it separated -- its presumption is NOT that teruma was separated
an agent is presumed to perform his agency
one who separates teruma without [the owner's] knowledge -- his teruma is not teruma
one whose kids and roosters were lost and who found them slaughtered -- R' Yehuda forbids [them]
R' Chanina son of R' Yosei HaGelili permits [them]
Rebbi: R' Yehuda's words appear [right] where he found them in a refuse heap
Rebbi: and R' Chanina's words [appear right] where he found them in a house
proposed: they disagree over whether we say that most found at slaughter are experts
[found] in a house -- all agree it is permitted
[found] in a refuse heap in the market -- all agree it is forbidden
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: where they disagree is a refuse heap in the house
one master holds: a man is prone to throw his carcass onto a refuse heap in the house
the other master holds: a man is not prone to throw his carcass onto a refuse heap in the house
Rebbi's 'refuse heap' is the refuse heap in the market
Rebbi's 'refuse heap' is the refuse heap in the house
Rebbi's 'house' is an actual house
Rebbi's 'house' is the refuse heap in the house

schemas.gloss_en: מה נפשך: if an agent is presumed to perform his agency, then teruma too [is presumed separated]; if he is not, then slaughter too [is not presumed done] -- either way the two rulings should agree

grounds.gloss_en: Rav Nachman: לכי תיכול עלה כורא דמילחא -- there is no presumption that an agent performs his agency; slaughter is presumed valid even if another heard and slaughtered, since most found at slaughter are experts, whereas teruma separated by another who heard is separated without the owner's knowledge and is not teruma

supports.gloss_en: מי לא תניא: הרי שמצא תרנגולת שחוטה בשוק... חזקתו שחוט -- אלמא אמרינן רוב מצויין אצל שחיטה מומחין הן (kind svara under protest: no support kind for a rhetorical מי לא תניא)
